text:
devon: Heads-up: I'll run the staging->prod overlay gating changes today. Quick Q: for service config we want a release-gating annotation on Deployment objects so CI can detect gated services before promote. Plan: add a kustomize patch under overlays/staging and a terraform var to flip the overlay to gated. Anyone see issues?

maria: Which CI job enforces this? We should fail fast if a Deployment is missing the annotation.

devon: CI job is `infra-release-gate` in `.github/workflows/release.yml` — right now it checks terraform plan for `apply_protected = true`. I want to extend it to also validate k8s manifests: look for `metadata.annotations.redwood/release-gated: "true"`.

alex: sgtm. For secrets note: staging overlay uses sops-encrypted secrets + kustomizeSecret.yaml — make sure decrypt step runs pre-apply. Also we should keep a rollback label for canary releases.

alex: ```yaml
# overlays/staging/patches/release-gate-deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
  annotations:
    redwood/release-gated: "true"
spec:
  template:
    metadata:
      annotations:
        deployment.kubernetes.io/revision: "staging-gate"
```

devon: I'll open a PR with a terraform var `release_gated = true` in `modules/overlays/staging/main.tf` plus the kustomize patch. Also will add a CI check to run: `kustomize build overlays/staging | yq '.items[] | select(.metadata.annotations."redwood/release-gated" == "true")'` and fail if the list is empty for services listed in the RELEASE_GATED list.

infra-bot: FAILURE: infra-release-gate — job failed on 1718234568 — missing annotation on overlays/staging/deployment.yaml :x:

maria: :eyes: I'll take this. I'll add a small validation script in `ci/validate_kustomize.py` to assert annotations and run it in pre-merge. Also quick question — do we want the gating annotation on all Deployments or only those routed by the gateway? I'd vote for an explicit list to avoid accidental gating.

alex: explicit is safer. Suggest a repo file `overlays/staging/RELEASE_GATED.txt` listing service names. CI can read that and assert those manifests have the annotation. infra-team — can we add that to the repo and wire CI to read it?

devon: Agree. I'll add `RELEASE_GATED.txt` and update `infra/README.md` with the process and rollback instructions. I'll tag @paul for the terraform PR review once it's ready.

maria: Thanks — ping me when PR is up and I'll review the kustomize/CI changes.

alex: For local testing: run `kustomize build overlays/staging | kubectl apply --dry-run=client -f -` and then `kustomize build overlays/staging | yq '.items[] | select(.metadata.annotations.redwood/release-gated=="true")'` to verify.

devon: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/248 — includes TF change + kustomize patch + `RELEASE_GATED.txt` + CI gating step in `.github/workflows/release.yml`. Please review by EOD.

maria: Got it, will review today.
